title: Realization fields of four-polytopes and simple-vertex deletion
abstract: A seventeen-vertex four-polytope has a face lattice realizable over a subfield of the reals exactly when that subfield contains the square root of five. In particular, this polytope has no rational realization. In every dimension, deleting a simple vertex from a full-dimensional nonsimplex yields a polytope of the same dimension whose face lattice is determined by the original marked face lattice. Deletion preserves all real realization fields and the density of rational labelled realizations.
